<!-- pr-reviewer: c9b1ed4a65325c5dcaedc9369f4d9e55264c029b -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The toolpath change is good and well pinned. One item blocks: the PR changes the UI and the body has no before/after screenshots.

Review tier: SAFETY. The change controls Circular toolpath geometry, entry certification and the posted program.

### What looks good

- Auto keeps its path. `ring_levels` keeps the old Auto ladder. The cert, the `top` plane and the retract are the same as before in Auto. `golden_cl` passes, and the two Circular CL goldens did not move.
- A forced order makes no assumption about a neighbour ring. Each ring runs a full ladder from the material cap (`circular_levels.rs:16-30`). The design is correct for Inside on a vault.
- A forced vault entry is certified against the disk of its own ring (`Cert::RingDisk`). `tangent_center` bounds the full helical sweep after lattice rounding, and it checks the minimum arc chord. A chord check on a disk is correct because the disk is convex.
- A retract plane inside the stock falls back to clearance, with a note (`circular.rs:247-252`). A clearance plane under the stock top is refused by name.
- The digest adds no bytes for Auto (`params/mill2d.rs:315-322`). The project key is omitted for Auto (`project/params.rs`), so old projects keep their stamp.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3359-circular-pass-start.md` gives the hand trace and the dropped options.

### Results (locally, trial-merged with upstream/main `ef1572114`)

- Motion: lib 540 passed, 10 ignored. `circular_ring_links` 6, `top_z_stock_over` 4, `circular_arcs` 5, `circular_helix_rings` 4, `circular_ramp_angle` 6, `center_cut_law` 7, `chamfer_circular` 7, `entry_ramp_angle` 5, `equal_steps` 13, `top_z_level` 13, `pass_start_levels` 5. All passed.
- App: `circular_ring_links` 6, `circular_entity_law` 5, `circular_pick` 4, `circular_pick_law` 5, `circular_stay_down` 2, `golden_cl` 33, `mill2d_b` 9, `offset_pass_start` 3 (2 ignored), `roughing2d` 7, `stock_source_law` 7, `top_z_stock_over` 6, `units_in_refusals` 5. All passed.
- App `example_catalog`: 37 passed, 4 ignored.
- UI: `camcraft-ui --lib` 1438 passed, 8 ignored.
- Clippy `-D warnings` on `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-ui` (all targets): clean.
- The full quick plan against upstream/main has 1102 steps, because the parent #3353 changes `camcraft-geometry`. I ran the focused suites above. I did not run the full plan.

Extra suites run: none were due. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.

Heavy lanes: not run - owed. The body reports a release-mode run on this head, but against the main of the integration commit `03929655b`, not against current upstream/main. The owed lanes are the `--ignored` lanes that the quick plan maps to motion and app (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`).

Goldens moved: none. No `*.cl`, `*.nc` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed.

### Mutations (each applied alone, then reverted)

1. `circular.rs:288`: `k = index` (Inside order ignored). RED: `circular_flat_pass_start_controls_every_ring_for_each_entry`, `circular_vault_inside_cuts_full_ladders_to_the_existing_ring_floors`.
2. `circular_levels.rs:21`: a forced vault uses the Auto ladder. RED: `circular_vault_inside_cuts_full_ladders_to_the_existing_ring_floors` (line 340).
3. `circular_helix.rs:172`: the orbit bound removed, and the helix centre moved outward. RED: `circular_vault_inside_cuts_full_ladders_to_the_existing_ring_floors`.
4. `circular.rs:252`: the configured retract plane kept inside the stock. RED: motion `top_z_stock_over::a_forced_vault_clearance_link_ignores_an_unused_lower_retract`.

### Requested before merge

1. **Screenshots of the UI change.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:336-337` adds the "Pass starts at" row and a hint to the Circular Passes tab. `kind_editors.rs:72` moves the Offset hint out of `pass_start_row`. Add before/after screenshots of the Circular Passes tab, and an after screenshot of the Offset pane, to the PR body. Put the images on an images-only branch and link them. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The PR base is `issue/3316-offset-pass-start` (#3353). The PR does not contain the current #3353 head `a91eb11d3`. I checked with `git merge-tree`: the merge with that head and with upstream/main is clean, and the two changes touch no common file. Retarget this PR to `main` before #3353 merges (AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack").
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:152` says that `pass_start` applies to a 2D Offset and that "other kinds get the same key in their own issues". After this PR, Circular also accepts the key through `edit_operation`. A follow-up can add Circular to that row. That is a process file, so its PR needs `Process change: yes`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/levels.rs` is 459 lines. It was 443 lines on upstream/main. The stack adds 16 lines, and this PR adds 6 of them.

The PR body now shows Circular Passes before and after the change. It also shows the Offset pane after the change. I checked that GitHub renders each image. The source head remains `c9b1ed4a6`.

I ran the release gate on trial merge `cdabd7105` with upstream `main` at `6e641dac7`. All 246 selected execution steps completed. 110 tests passed, and the gate reproduced four registered expected failures. There were zero unexpected failures. Each selected suite compiled on demand.

Ready for a re-check.
